name: Tao Dong
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Tao Dong, the founder of Duotail.

I'm a software engineer and a dad. I built Duotail so the next generation can have something mine never did: an inbox they truly own, where only the people they choose can reach them, and that stays worry-free for life.
I've spent 20 years building software, more than 10 of them on email products. I shared the thinking behind Duotail in my essay, How to Secure Every Email Inbox on the Internet.
emailNote: Write to tao.dong_feedback@duotail.com. It's a Cold Reach Allowed address, the kind Duotail suggests for a business card: anyone can introduce themselves once, and I decide who can write again.
